## What Makes A&S Contracting Services Different from Other Contractors

### Self-Performed Work Model
A&S Contracting Services operates with a self-performed work model that eliminates subcontractors entirely. Every trade—roofing, siding, gutters, drywall, windows, and interior finish work—is performed by A&S's own crew. This approach delivers:
- Direct accountability: the owner and crew answering phones are the same people on your roof
- Consistent quality across every trade
- No coordination gaps between multiple subcontractors
- Predictable timelines from start to final walkthrough
- One point of contact for the entire project

### Same Crew, Start to Finish
Unlike construction companies that rotate crews between projects, A&S assigns the same team to your job from the initial site visit through the final walkthrough. This ensures:
- Continuity in workmanship and project knowledge
- No learning curve as new workers join mid-project
- Relationships built with the homeowner
- Accountability for every phase of work

### Licensed & Insured in Missouri
A&S Contracting Services holds a Missouri general contractor license and carries full liability insurance. This credential allows the company to:
- Pull permits for major renovations and additions
- Handle structural work beyond cosmetic repairs
- Take on commercial projects in addition to residential work
- Provide documentation that meets lender and insurance requirements

### Service Area & Regional Knowledge
Operating within 50 miles of Warrenton, A&S serves Warren County and the surrounding central Missouri region. This tight geographic focus means:
- Same-day or next-day site visits for estimates
- Familiarity with local weather patterns (hail belt, freeze-thaw cycles, humidity)
- Knowledge of soil conditions that impact foundation drainage and gutter placement
- Established relationships with local building inspectors and suppliers
- Responsiveness for warranty service and follow-up visits

### No Trade Gaps
Many contractors specialize in one trade and refer out related work. A&S handles:
- Roofing (tear-off, installation, storm damage repair)
- Siding (vinyl, fiber cement, wood)
- Gutters (seamless aluminum, repairs, full replacement)
- Soffit and fascia (ventilation, pest blocking, trim finishing)
- Windows and doors (energy-efficient replacements, weather sealing)
- Drywall (installation, finishing, repair)
- Interior trim, paint, and full room additions

This eliminates the coordination headache of managing multiple contractors, ensures materials and finishes match across trades, and provides one accountable team standing behind the entire project.

### Free Written Estimates with No Upselling
Every estimate is free, on-site, and provided in writing. The quote includes:
- Itemized material costs
- Labor breakdown
- Start window (within days or weeks)
- Completion timeline
- Payment terms

The quoted price is the final price—no hidden fees, no change orders for "discovered issues" that should have been visible during the estimate.

### Storm & Hail Insurance Claim Support
Missouri sits in a high-hail zone. A&S documents storm damage with photos, provides detailed itemized estimates to match insurance adjuster line items, and meets with adjusters on-site to ensure the claim covers the full scope of repair. Homeowners receive guidance through the claims process from initial inspection through installation sign-off.

## Detailed Service Descriptions

### Roofing Services
A&S Contracting Services provides comprehensive roofing installation, repair, and replacement for residential and commercial properties throughout Warren County. Services include:

#### Roof Tear-Off & Full Replacement
Complete roof replacement begins with tear-off of existing shingles, underlayment, and damaged decking. The crew inspects all roof sheathing for rot or structural damage, replaces compromised sections, installs synthetic underlayment, applies drip edge and ice-water shield in valleys and eaves, and installs new architectural asphalt shingles or metal roofing.

Typical single-family roof replacement takes 1-3 days depending on weather and complexity. The site is kept clean daily, with magnetic sweeps for stray nails and protection of landscaping.

#### Storm & Hail Damage Repair
Missouri's hail belt subjects roofs to impact damage that often isn't visible from the ground. A&S inspects for:
- Dented or cracked shingles
- Granule loss (exposed asphalt)
- Impact marks on flashing, gutters, and vents
- Underlying deck damage

The inspection is documented with photos scaled to show impact severity. A&S provides a detailed repair estimate formatted to match insurance line items, meets with the adjuster on-site, and works with homeowners to ensure the claim proceeds smoothly from documentation through installation.

#### Insurance Claim Documentation
A&S provides:
- Photo documentation of all visible damage
- Itemized repair estimates with material specifications
- On-site meetings with insurance adjusters
- Follow-up correspondence with adjusters and homeowners
- Guidance on depreciation, deductibles, and supplement claims

This service is included at no additional charge for storm-related roofing work.

#### Architectural Asphalt Shingles
A&S installs dimensional asphalt shingles from major manufacturers in a range of colors and profiles. These shingles carry 25-50 year warranties (depending on the product line), resist algae growth, and provide traditional aesthetics that match most Warren County home styles.

#### Impact-Resistant Shingles
For homeowners in hail-prone areas or those seeking insurance discounts, A&S offers Class 4 impact-resistant shingles. These products meet UL 2218 impact testing standards and may qualify for premium reductions with Missouri insurers.

#### Metal Roofing Installation
Metal roofing provides 50+ year lifespans, superior hail resistance, and reduced cooling costs. A&S installs standing-seam and corrugated metal in steel or aluminum. Metal roofs shed snow and ice, resist fire, and require minimal maintenance over their lifespan.

### Siding Services
A&S installs and repairs residential and light commercial siding in vinyl, fiber cement, and wood. Siding work includes:

#### Vinyl Siding Installation
Vinyl siding offers low maintenance, fade resistance, and a clean finish at a lower cost than fiber cement or wood. A&S installs insulated and non-insulated vinyl in a range of colors and profiles. Each installation includes:
- Housewrap or moisture barrier
- Proper J-channel and trim detailing around windows and doors
- Ventilation clearances for soffit and attic airflow
- Weather-tight lapping and fastening to manufacturer specifications

#### Fiber Cement Siding
Fiber cement (such as James Hardie HardiePlank) resists rot, pests, and fire. It accepts paint finish and provides a wood-like appearance with far greater durability. A&S installs fiber cement with corrosion-resistant fasteners, proper flashing at all penetrations, and caulked joints where specified. Fiber cement requires repainting every 10-15 years but resists the warping and splitting common to natural wood.

#### Wood Siding
For homeowners seeking traditional wood aesthetics, A&S installs cedar, pine, or engineered wood siding. Wood siding requires periodic staining or painting but provides unmatched natural beauty. A&S applies moisture barriers, installs with proper expansion gaps, and seals all cut ends to prevent water intrusion.

#### Weather-Tight Installation
Missouri experiences freeze-thaw cycles, heavy summer humidity, and wind-driven rain. Every siding installation includes:
- Proper overlap and fastening to resist wind uplift
- Flashing above all windows, doors, and trim
- Housewrap continuity with no gaps at seams
- Weep holes in J-channel to allow moisture escape

#### Curb Appeal Enhancement
Fresh siding transforms a home's exterior. A&S helps homeowners select colors and profiles that complement existing roofing, trim, and neighborhood character. The crew coordinates siding with fascia, soffit, and trim for a cohesive finished appearance.

### Gutter Services
A&S installs, repairs, and replaces seamless aluminum gutter systems throughout Warren County. Services include:

#### Seamless Aluminum Gutter Systems
Seamless gutters are fabricated on-site to match the home's exact measurements, eliminating leaky seams common in sectional gutters. A&S installs 5" or 6" K-style gutters in a range of colors, matched to the home's trim or siding. Each installation includes:
- Hidden hangers spaced for snow load and roof pitch
- Properly pitched runs (minimum 1/4" per 10 feet) for positive drainage
- End caps sealed with industrial gutter sealant
- Downspouts routed away from the foundation

#### Foundation Protection
Gutters exist to protect foundations. A&S routes downspouts at least 6 feet from the foundation or connects them to underground drain lines where grading permits. Proper gutter installation prevents:
- Basement water intrusion
- Soil erosion at the foundation perimeter
- Settling and cracking caused by saturated soil
- Staining and mildew on siding and trim

#### Gutter Repair & Full Replacement
A&S repairs sagging gutters, replaces damaged sections, reseals leaking joints, and clears blockages. For gutters beyond repair—those with extensive rust, separation from fascia, or pervasive leaks—A&S provides full replacement with new seamless aluminum systems.

#### Professional Installation
Gutter work requires roof access, fascia assessment, and coordination with roofing and soffit trades. A&S crews handle all three trades in-house, ensuring gutters integrate properly with the roof drip edge, fascia boards are replaced if rotted, and soffit ventilation is maintained.

### Soffit Services
Soffit (the underside of roof eaves) provides attic ventilation, blocks pests, and finishes the roofline. A&S installs and repairs soffit in aluminum and vinyl, including:

#### Improved Attic Ventilation
Vented soffit panels allow fresh air to enter the attic, working with ridge vents or gable vents to create continuous airflow. Proper ventilation:
- Reduces attic heat in summer (lowering cooling costs)
- Prevents moisture buildup that leads to mold and deck rot
- Extends shingle life by keeping the roof deck cooler

A&S ensures soffit vents are not blocked by insulation, that vent-to-solid panel ratios meet code, and that airflow paths remain clear.

#### Blocks Pests & Moisture
Exposed rafter tails and open eaves invite birds, squirrels, bats, and insects into the attic. Soffit closes these gaps while maintaining ventilation. A&S seals all joints, trims soffit tight to fascia and siding, and blocks entry points without restricting airflow.

#### Matched to Roofline
Soffit finish must coordinate with fascia, siding, and trim. A&S offers white, almond, and custom-color soffit to match the home's existing palette. Soffit panels are cut and fitted to align with fascia boards, window trim, and siding corners for a cohesive roofline appearance.

### Fascia Services
Fascia (the vertical trim board at the roof edge) supports gutters and finishes the roofline. A&S replaces rotted fascia, installs aluminum-wrapped fascia, and coordinates fascia with soffit and gutter work.

#### Protects Roof Edges
Fascia covers the ends of roof rafters, blocking water intrusion and providing a substrate for gutter mounting. Damaged or rotted fascia allows water into the eave structure, leading to rafter rot, soffit failure, and gutter detachment. A&S inspects fascia during every roof and gutter estimate, replacing compromised boards before installing new gutters.

#### Replaces Rotted Boards
Wood fascia deteriorates from gutter overflow, ice dam backup, and prolonged moisture exposure. A&S removes rotted sections, installs pressure-treated or composite replacement boards, and wraps them in aluminum coil stock for long-term protection. Aluminum wrapping eliminates painting and resists rot indefinitely.

#### Clean, Matched Finish
Fascia is visible from the street and must coordinate with soffit, trim, and siding colors. A&S offers white, almond, and custom-color aluminum fascia wrap, matched to the homeowner's existing trim palette. Wrapped fascia provides a crisp, maintenance-free finish that lasts decades.

### Windows & Doors
A&S installs energy-efficient replacement windows and entry doors, including:

#### Energy-Efficient Replacement Windows
Old windows with single-pane glass, broken seals, or rotted frames waste heating and cooling energy. A&S installs vinyl, fiberglass, or composite replacement windows with:
- Low-E glass coatings to reduce UV and heat transfer
- Argon or krypton gas fills between panes
- Multi-point locking hardware
- Insulated frames that resist condensation

Window replacement includes full perimeter flashing, spray foam insulation in the rough opening, and interior/exterior trim finishing.

#### Patio Doors & Entry Doors
A&S installs sliding patio doors, French doors, and steel or fiberglass entry doors. Entry door installation includes:
- Weatherstripping and threshold sealing
- Deadbolt and lockset hardware
- Brick mold or casing trim
- Storm door installation where requested

Patio doors receive full sill pan flashing, spray foam insulation, and alignment to prevent drafts and water intrusion.

#### Professional Weather Sealing
Missouri's temperature swings (100°F summers, 0°F winters) demand tight weather sealing. A&S caulks all window and door perimeters, applies expanding foam in voids, installs drip cap flashing above all openings, and tests for air leaks before final trim installation.

### Full-Scale Interior Work
A&S handles comprehensive interior renovations, including:

#### Drywall Installation, Finishing & Repair
A&S hangs, tapes, and finishes drywall for room additions, remodels, and repairs. Services include:
- Framing inspection and correction before hanging
- Acoustic or moisture-resistant drywall where code requires
- Taped and mudded seams with 3-coat finishing
- Sanded smooth for Level 4 or Level 5 finish (texture or paint-ready)
- Repair of cracks, holes, and water-damaged sections

#### Trim & Painting
Interior trim (baseboards, door casings, crown molding) is installed after drywall finishing. A&S miter-cuts joints, caulks seams, and primes/paints trim and walls. Homeowners may choose to self-paint or have A&S complete the finish painting as part of the project scope.

#### Room Additions & Full Interior Remodels
A&S holds a general contractor license, allowing the company to handle structural work beyond cosmetic updates. Services include:
- Room additions (framed, roofed, drywalled, and finished)
- Kitchen and bathroom remodels
- Basement finishing
- Load-bearing wall removal or installation (with engineered beams)
- Permit pulling and inspection coordination

The same crew that handles roofing and siding performs interior framing, drywall, and trim, providing accountability across every trade.

#### Clean Job Site Maintenance Daily
Interior work generates dust, debris, and material scraps. A&S maintains a clean job site:
- Daily sweeping and vacuuming
- Dust barriers between work zones and occupied areas
- Disposal of scrap lumber, drywall, and packaging
- Final cleaning before walkthrough

### Exterior Work (Full Exterior Renovations)
A&S coordinates siding, roofing, gutter, soffit, fascia, and trim work as a unified exterior renovation. This approach delivers:
- Coordinated material orders (one delivery, matched colors, bulk pricing)
- Efficient sequencing (roofing → gutters → siding → trim)
- One accountable crew across all trades
- Unified warranty coverage

Homeowners needing multiple exterior trades benefit from the self-performed model: no waiting for separate contractors, no coordination gaps, and one phone number for questions or warranty service.

### Drywall Services
A&S provides standalone drywall services for remodels, repairs, and additions:
- New drywall installation (residential and commercial)
- Ceiling repair after roof leaks
- Hole and crack patching
- Textured ceiling matching
- Smooth Level 4 and Level 5 finishes

Drywall work is scheduled as part of larger projects or as a standalone service for homeowners managing their own renovations.

### General Contracting
A&S serves as the general contractor for residential and light commercial construction projects, managing:
- Permit applications and inspections
- Subcontractor coordination (when specialized trades like HVAC or electrical are required)
- Material procurement and scheduling
- Quality control across all phases
- Owner communication and budget management

For projects requiring trades A&S does not self-perform (such as plumbing or electrical), the company acts as the general contractor, hiring and managing licensed subcontractors while self-performing all carpentry, roofing, siding, drywall, and trim work.

## Project Pricing, Estimates & Timelines

### Free On-Site Estimates
Every project begins with a free, no-obligation on-site estimate. Blake Alger or a senior crew member visits the property, inspects the existing conditions, discusses the homeowner's goals, and provides a detailed written estimate within 1-3 business days.

### Estimate Components
Written estimates include:
- **Itemized material costs**: Shingles, siding, gutters, lumber, fasteners, etc. with manufacturer and product line specified
- **Labor breakdown**: Tear-off, installation, finishing, cleanup
- **Start window**: "We can begin the week of [date]" or "2-3 weeks from contract signing"
- **Completion timeline**: "1-3 days for tear-off and roofing" or "5-7 business days for siding"
- **Payment terms**: Deposit (typically 30-50% for material procurement), progress payments, and final payment upon completion
- **Warranty coverage**: Material warranties (manufacturer) and workmanship warranty (A&S)

### Pricing Factors
Cost depends on:
- **Square footage**: Roof, siding, and drywall are priced per square foot or square (100 square feet)
- **Materials selected**: Architectural shingles vs. metal roofing; vinyl vs. fiber cement siding; standard vs. insulated windows
- **Existing condition**: Rotted sheathing, fascia, or framing requires replacement before new materials are installed
- **Complexity**: Steep roofs, multi-story homes, intricate trim details, and difficult access increase labor time
- **Scope of work**: Does the project include related trades (gutters with roofing, soffit with siding)?

A&S does not provide "ballpark" estimates over the phone. Accurate pricing requires on-site measurement and assessment.

### No Hidden Fees, No Upselling
The written estimate is the contract price. A&S does not:
- Add "discovery" charges for conditions visible during the estimate
- Upsell unnecessary services
- Change orders unless the homeowner requests additional work mid-project

If unexpected structural issues are found during tear-off (such as rafter rot not visible from below), A&S documents the issue with photos, explains the repair required, and provides a supplemental cost estimate before proceeding.

### Scheduling & Lead Times
A&S schedules projects within days to weeks of contract signing, depending on weather and current workload. Typical lead times:
- **Roof replacement**: 1-3 weeks from signing to start date
- **Siding projects**: 2-4 weeks
- **Interior remodels**: Varies by scope; room additions may require 4-8 weeks for permitting and material procurement

Once scheduled, the same crew remains on the project until completion. A&S does not "hop" between jobs, leaving projects incomplete for weeks.

### Typical Project Timelines
- **Roof replacement (single-family home)**: 1-3 days (weather permitting)
- **Siding installation (1,500-2,000 square feet)**: 5-10 business days
- **Gutter installation (full house)**: 1-2 days
- **Drywall finishing (500 square feet)**: 3-5 days including drying time between coats
- **Room addition (framing through finish)**: 6-12 weeks depending on size and complexity

All timelines are provided in writing during the estimate phase.

## Insurance Claims — Storm & Hail Damage Support

Missouri sits in a high-hail corridor. A&S assists homeowners with storm damage insurance claims from inspection through installation:

### Damage Documentation
A&S inspects roofs, siding, gutters, and windows for storm damage, documenting:
- Impact marks on shingles (dents, cracks, granule loss)
- Hail dents on gutters, flashing, vents, and siding
- Wind damage (lifted shingles, torn underlayment)
- Interior water stains indicating roof penetration

Photos are scaled and annotated to demonstrate impact severity. A&S provides a written inspection report and itemized repair estimate formatted to match insurance line items.

### Meeting with Insurance Adjusters
A&S schedules on-site meetings with insurance adjusters, walking them through the damage and explaining the scope of repair. This ensures:
- The adjuster sees all damage (not just what's visible from the ground)
- The estimate covers the full scope of necessary repairs
- Materials specified meet code and manufacturer requirements

Many adjusters initially underestimate damage scope. A&S provides supplemental documentation when the adjuster's initial estimate falls short.

### Navigating the Claims Process
A&S guides homeowners through:
- **Deductibles**: Understanding how the deductible is applied to the claim payout
- **Depreciation**: Explaining recoverable depreciation (paid after completion) vs. actual cash value (paid upfront)
- **Supplements**: Requesting additional coverage when hidden damage is found during tear-off
- **Code upgrades**: Securing coverage for code-required upgrades (such as underlayment standards)

This service is included at no additional charge for storm-related work.

### Smooth Progression from Inspection to Installation
Once the claim is approved and the homeowner signs a contract, A&S schedules the work and coordinates directly with the insurance company's payment schedule. The homeowner pays only their deductible; A&S invoices the insurance carrier for the remaining balance.

## Quality, Accountability & Workmanship Standards

### Licensed & Insured
A&S Contracting Services holds a Missouri general contractor license and maintains:
- **General liability insurance**: Covers property damage and third-party injury during the project
- **Workers' compensation insurance**: Protects crew members in case of on-site injury (eliminating homeowner liability)

Homeowners should verify that any contractor carries both coverages before signing a contract. Unlicensed or uninsured contractors expose homeowners to financial liability if someone is injured on the property.

### Same Crew, Start to Finish
A&S assigns the same crew to each project from first day to final walkthrough. This ensures:
- Continuity in workmanship and project knowledge
- Accountability: the crew completing the work is the same crew handling warranty service
- Relationship building with the homeowner

Many contractors rotate crews between projects, leading to inconsistent quality and loss of project context. A&S avoids this by committing one team to one job until completion.

### One Accountable Team
A&S's owner, Blake Alger, oversees every project. Homeowners have direct access to the owner via phone or text throughout the project. If a question arises about materials, timeline, or workmanship, the owner responds directly—no gatekeepers, no voicemail loops.

### Clean Job Site Daily
Construction generates debris. A&S maintains a clean site:
- **Daily cleanup**: Scrap materials, empty packaging, and waste are removed at the end of each workday
- **Magnetic sweeps**: Roofing nails are swept with magnets to protect tires, pets, and children
- **Dust barriers** (interior work): Plastic sheeting isolates work areas from occupied living spaces
- **Final cleaning**: Before the final walkthrough, the site is broom-swept and inspected for any remaining debris

### Final Walkthrough on Every Project
Before requesting final payment, A&S conducts a walkthrough with the homeowner, reviewing the completed work and addressing any concerns. The project is not considered complete until the homeowner confirms satisfaction.

### Professional Documentation & Communication
A&S provides:
- Written estimates with itemized costs and timelines
- Signed contracts before work begins
- Photo documentation of "before" conditions and completed work
- Receipts and invoices detailing materials and labor

Throughout the project, the crew communicates progress, arrival times, and any changes to the schedule. Homeowners are never left wondering when the crew will arrive or what remains to be done.

## Service Philosophy & Founding Story

A&S Contracting Services was founded in 2023 by Blake Alger with a focus on roofing and exterior construction. The business began as a response to the fragmented nature of the residential construction industry—homeowners hiring separate contractors for roofing, siding, gutters, and trim, coordinating schedules, chasing warranty claims, and dealing with finger-pointing when work didn't align.

Blake built A&S around a self-performed work model: one crew handles every trade. No subcontractors, no coordination gaps, no excuses. If the siding doesn't align with the trim, A&S fixes it—because the same crew installed both. If the gutters overflow because they weren't pitched correctly, A&S corrects them—because the same crew mounted them to fascia A&S replaced.

The company expanded from roofing to include siding, gutters, soffit, fascia, windows, drywall, and interior finish work. Today, A&S operates as a licensed general contractor capable of handling full exterior renovations, room additions, and comprehensive remodels—all with the same self-performed, one-crew accountability model.

Every project is handled by the same team from the initial estimate through final walkthrough, providing consistent quality across Warren County and central Missouri. The owner answers the phone, visits the site, and oversees every project. No call centers, no sales commissions, no rotating crews—just accountable craftsmanship backed by a Missouri contractor license and full insurance coverage.
